note: Interactive browser workspace. It does not claim native packages, encrypted storage, OS notifications, cloud sync, medical advice or live external services.

applications.name: Капсульный шкаф
applications.privacy_boundary: Wardrobe entries remain in the local browser profile.

applications.name: Сроки косметики
applications.privacy_boundary: PAO is a user-entered packaging estimate, not a product safety certification.

applications.name: Посадка и силуэты
applications.privacy_boundary: No body measurements, photos or body scoring are required.

applications.name: Пауза перед покупкой
applications.privacy_boundary: No store accounts, purchases or payment actions are connected.

applications.name: Уход по среде
applications.privacy_boundary: No geolocation or live weather lookup; values are entered manually.

applications.name: Цикл и энергия
applications.privacy_boundary: Cycle notes are memory-only and never written to localStorage or export.

applications.name: Мягкий чек-ин
applications.privacy_boundary: Wellbeing check-ins are memory-only and cleared when the page closes.

applications.name: Движение по силам
applications.privacy_boundary: General ideas only; no medical or rehabilitation prescription.

applications.name: План чек-апов
applications.privacy_boundary: User-entered appointment dates only; no medical results requested.

applications.name: Дом без перегруза
applications.privacy_boundary: Assignments are labels; no household member is contacted.

applications.name: Чемодан за 5 минут
applications.privacy_boundary: No route or location is collected.

applications.name: Уютные места
applications.privacy_boundary: Place notes are subjective and unverified; no live location or safety guarantee.

applications.name: Круг по интересам
applications.privacy_boundary: No public profiles, chat, discovery or external invitations.

applications.name: Карьерный дневник
applications.privacy_boundary: Records stay in the local browser profile and are included in user-requested export.

applications.name: Мои проекты
applications.privacy_boundary: Project data is user-managed and remains local.
